root_cause.defect: String(std::string_view) is noexcept but calls assign, which can throw AllocationError.
root_cause.reproduction: Isolated Linux subprocess malloc interposition rejects allocations >=1 MiB only after creating the 2 MiB source text; source remains valid. No system-wide changes or allocation limits are used.
root_cause.control: Default-constructed String.assign(valid_source) throws AllocationError and the caller catches it; exit 0.
root_cause.failure: String(valid_source) calls terminate before the caller can catch AllocationError; custom terminate handler exits 86.
root_cause.implication: Removing Multimedia noexcept barriers or adding worker catch clauses alone cannot recover exceptions that terminate inside Base.

other_confirmed_contract_risks: Safe::Optional engaged construction/copy and Safe::Vector growth allocate through Heap::Allocate.
NLMeans scratch Vector allocation is called through noexcept FilterPlane and Process.
Registry and private catalog initialization allocate under noexcept.
Pumper, Filter::FFmpeg and StageTelemetry failure-message Optional construction can itself allocate.
Worker Setup/Process/Flush and plugin processing interfaces currently require noexcept; changing leaf declarations alone is insufficient.
guarded_access_findings: AVFormatContext decoder and bitstream-filter expected.value() calls have guards.
OCR TessData expected.value() has a has_value() guard.
Plan registry expected.value() calls are short-circuit guarded.
Registry::Resolve skips missing codec lookups before value().
Muxer::Disposition uses contains before at; configuration is externally serialized.
Backend transcoder optional accesses inspected have value-presence guards.
DurationProgress Safe::Function constructor receives all required nonnull callbacks and a make_unique context; its explicit invalid-callback exception is not reachable absent allocation failure.
